selections.comment: CALL MARGOT didn't beat a rival home on debut but it came against a field of previous winners at Listed level and she wasn't beaten that far despite racing freely. She should improve significantly if settling and can take advantage of getting weight from her main rivals dropping in grade. Argentine Tango's debut form is working out well and she holds Miss Piggle on a line through that rival's conqueror last time. She is the more likely of the pair to defy a penalty and can chase the selection home ahead of There's A Chance who travelled best before being worried out of it on debut. That filly will appreciate the quick surface.

Latynina is closely related to top class miler Zonderland and is worth a market check ahead of her debut.

CITY CYCLONE makes most appeal, he is 3/4 over C&D and won only beaten a short-head last time out at Lingfield.

selections.comment: Impossible to oppose NO SUCH THING who sets a clear standard on both his 2yo form and his efforts this spring. His penultimate run has been boosted at Listed level since and he should outclass these. Spent All Me Money shaped with promise on debut in the spring and though he was disappointing next time he should be chasing the selection home in a weak race. Beat The Devil's debut wasn't devoid of promise and he could fight for a place if breaking on terms.

Newcomer Spinning Around makes some appeal on pedigree and his top yard has had a couple of winning newcomers already this year. Any market support for her would be significant.

The selection put up a good speed figure earlier in the season and should get a good pace to aim at here. Mullacash Buzz ran poorly last time but was in good form on the AW previously. He's well treated on his form on that surface and can make his presence felt with the assistance of Keane for the first time.

selections.comment: A clear match race between OMNI MAN and Mocking. The latter travelled best and came clear with the eventual winner on handicap debut just getting outstayed late. Dropping back in distance he holds obvious claims but the selection has achieved more in his maiden runs. He's shown a consistent level of form and is penultimate run in particular is working out well. There is enough stamina on his dam's side to suggest he will see out the longer trip at this sharp track.

selections.comment: AEON'S AEGIS showed a consistent level of form in novices and can take advantage of a lenient opening mark here. He is bred to relish this step up in trip and the faster surface so should progress for his top yard. Bright N Shine was well held over hurdles last time but was in good form last autumn on the flat and rates a danger on the favourable fast surface but it is Zipster who looks the biggest danger. He's been let down by slow starts of late enduring troubled passages but his reappearance effort has been boosted several times since suggesting he's capable here if his stamina holds up.

selections.comment: Those returning from hurdling may fight this out with PREPARATIONS appealing most. She was outclassed at Graded level last time but was a winner on her previous couple of starts in both codes and remains open to plenty of improvement. She looks on a fair mark on her hurdles and flat form and could be tough to catch from a good draw. The same can be said of Ragmans Corner who is unexposed in this sphere and easily forgiven his latest hurdles run as she bled. He will need a stiff test but will be staying on at the finish. Consistent maiden Ozark Daze completes the list of dangers returning to handicpas off a potentially generous mark.

selections.comment: ANTOINE DE PARIS did well to finish as close as he did last time having missed the break and if the blinkers shapern him up at the gates he could be tough to beat with Keane taking over in the saddle. Enziya was behind him that day having also blown his chance at the gates. He's already proven over this far and could get closer to the selection. Onemoredance beat a next time out winner last time and is the biggest threat to the pair with the longer trip in her favour.
